name: Gmail
description: Gmail (and IMAP/SMTP) plugin for OpenClaw using App Passwords. Server-side IMAP search with Gmail X-GM-RAW, multi-term AND, hasAttachment, thread fetch, HTML→text fallback, and attachment download to disk.

username.description: Full email address used as both IMAP and SMTP username

appPassword.description: Gmail App Password (16 characters, no spaces). Generate at https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords

attachmentsDir.description: Directory where attachments are saved. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/inbox/gmail.

requireExplicitSendConfirmation.description: When true, send and reply tools require confirm=true.

appPassword.label: App Password
appPassword.help: Generate at https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords. Requires 2FA enabled on your Google account.

fromName.label: Display name
fromName.help: Name shown to recipients (e.g. Manuel Fedele)

requireExplicitSendConfirmation.label: Require send confirmation
requireExplicitSendConfirmation.help: Block accidental sends. When enabled the agent must pass confirm=true to send/reply.
